summary: A survival base-building foundation, 3.0 x 3.0 m and 1.0 m tall: a plank deck on a frame of round log beams a… options tier; sockets socket_top, socket_edge_front, socket_edge_back, socket_edge_left, socket_edge_right.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.base_foundation_wood or place "prefab": "base_foundation_wood" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d().
